description: Search eBay listings live via SerpAPI (engine `ebay`). Returns organic_results (each with title, link, condition, price, shipping, seller and — crucially — a `product_id`), plus categories, related_searches and pagination. Provide `_nkw` (a free-text query, what you'd type in eBay's search box) and/or a `category_id` to browse a category. Filter by price (`_udlo`/`_udhi`), condition (`LH_ItemCondition`), buying format (`buying_format`), seller (`_sasl`) and more; sort with `_sop` and paginate with `_pgn`. Pass a result's `product_id` to the `ebay_product` tool for full item details. Prices are in the marketplace currency (set via `ebay_domain`, default ebay.com).

LH_ItemCondition.description: Item condition id(s), pipe-separated for multiple ('1000|3000'): 1000 New, 1500 Open box, 2500 Seller refurbished, 3000 Used, 7000 For parts/not working, 10 Not specified.

LH_PrefLoc.description: Preferred item location: 'Domestic', 'Regional' or 'Worldwide' (mapped internally to SerpAPI's numeric LH_PrefLoc codes — the words themselves are rejected by the upstream API).

_blrs.description: Set to 'spell_auto_correct' to exclude results from an auto-corrected spelling of the query.

_dmd.description: Result layout: 'Grid' or 'List'. Cosmetic; does not change the items returned.

_nkw.description: Search query — anything you'd type in eBay's search box. Required unless category_id is set.

_salic.description: Filter items by location, as a country code (e.g. '1' for US — see eBay location ids).

_sasl.description: Seller username(s) to filter by, comma-separated.

_saslop.description: How to apply _sasl: 1 = only these sellers (default), 2 = exclude these sellers.

_sop.description: Sort order code: '12' = Best Match (default), '1' = ending soonest, '10' = newly listed, '15' = price+shipping lowest first, '16' = price+shipping highest first.

_stpos.description: Buyer ZIP/postal code, used for location- and shipping-based filtering.

buying_format.description: Buying format filter: 'Auction', 'BIN' (Buy It Now) or 'BO' (Best Offer).

category_id.description: eBay category id to concentrate the search in. Can be used with or instead of _nkw.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

show_only.description: Extra filters, comma-separated: Sold, Complete (sold & completed listings), FS (free shipping), FR (free returns), RPA (returns accepted), Lots, Charity, Savings, SaleItems, AS, AV, LPickup.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.
